senses.definition_en: mental and physical; physico-mental, psychosomatic

examples.english: Experience always wavers between what is physico-mentally and culturally possible, and what is built up from said possibility.
examples.ref: 2005, Eugenia Ramírez Goicoechea, “Evolución, cultura y complejidad”, in Evolution, Culture, and Complexity, page 165:
examples.text: La experiencia siempre está a caballo entre lo que es corporomental y culturalmente posible y lo que se construye a partir de dicha posibilidad.
examples.translation: Experience always wavers between what is physico-mentally and culturally possible, and what is built up from said possibility.

examples.english: It [the self] has a certain continuity — socioculturally determined in time — and a certain correspondence with other aspects and domains of psysico-mental activity recognized as one's own.
examples.ref: 2006, Luis Alvarez Munarriz, Enrique Couceiro Domínguez, “La conciencia humana”, in Human Consciousness, page 99:
examples.text: Tiene cierta continuidad — socioculturalmente determinada en el tiempo — y cierta correspondencia con otros aspectos y dominios de actividad corporomental reconocidos como propios.
examples.translation: It [the self] has a certain continuity — socioculturally determined in time — and a certain correspondence with other aspects and domains of psysico-mental activity recognized as one's own.

examples.english: It materializes as a psysico-mental record of our experiences, conscious or otherwise, whose result is a specific neurological pattern, or pattern of neurological patterns.
examples.ref: 2007, Eugenia Ramírez Goicoechea, “Etnicidad, identidad y migraciones”, in Ethnicity, Identity, and Migrations, page 205:
examples.text: Se materializa como inscripción corporomental de nuestras experiencias, conscientes o no, cuyo resultado es un determinado patrón neurológico, o patrón de patrones neurológicos.
examples.translation: It materializes as a psysico-mental record of our experiences, conscious or otherwise, whose result is a specific neurological pattern, or pattern of neurological patterns.

glosses: mental and physical; physico-mental, psychosomatic
